_comment: Deployment-gate configuration. The scan-language matrix is derived strictly from the packs: keys of codeql-config.yml via languageMap (a new pack language cannot be added without also gaining a floor + fixtures here, or the gate fails). Bumping a floor or expected rule id is a reviewed diff, never a magic number in a workflow.

actions._comment: Dormant until codeql-config.yml gains an actions: packs key (PR #19). Floor is 17 for the built-in Actions suite; raise to 20 once actions-custom-queries is pinned, and add the three custom rule ids to expectedRuleIds.
